variants.name: rug-forest-leaf
variants.theme: Forest leaf rug. A flat oval woven mat in sage, moss and soft olive green with a straw-beige braided rim. Three large simple leaf silhouettes and restrained vein lines form a readable centered pattern. Low contrast pale center where a creature can stand; a few leaf-shaped edge accents kept within the original ellipse. Clearly flat textile, very thin rim.
variants.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: standalone replaceable furniture sprite for StickMon, a small-screen cozy creature-care game.
Primary request: Create a new design variant of the furniture in input image 1. Input image 1 is the geometry, camera and rendering reference. Input image 2 is only a room style and palette reference.
Style: match the references' cozy hand-painted pixel-art-inspired game asset style, crisp stepped contours, compact clusters of color, restrained shading and a dark warm outline. Simple broad shapes that remain legible when reduced to roughly 100 pixels wide for a rug, or 75 pixels wide for a bed. Avoid tiny ornamental texture.
Camera/geometry: retain image 1's elevated front view, horizontally aligned elliptical footprint and approximate width-to-height proportion. Same camera tilt, symmetric left/right presentation, lower edge facing the viewer.
Composition: exactly ONE complete furniture object, centered with generous transparent padding, no clipping. Object only; do not depict the room or any floor/platform. Real transparent alpha background, not white and not a checkerboard. No drop shadow outside the object; restrained self-shading is allowed.
Constraints: no characters, creatures, people, text, captions, labels, UI, logos, watermark, extra furniture, floor tiles, scenic backgrounds, collage or contact sheet. 
Design variation: Forest leaf rug. A flat oval woven mat in sage, moss and soft olive green with a straw-beige braided rim. Three large simple leaf silhouettes and restrained vein lines form a readable centered pattern. Low contrast pale center where a creature can stand; a few leaf-shaped edge accents kept within the original ellipse. Clearly flat textile, very thin rim.

variants.name: rug-starry-night
variants.theme: Starry night rug. A flat oval woven mat with a muted deep-indigo braided border, dusty blue inner field, a pale-gold crescent moon and three large simple stars spaced around the inner border. Broad quiet center that keeps a standing creature visible. Restrained cozy night palette, gold stitching, very thin rim. All motifs are woven into the flat rug.

variants.name: rug-cloud
variants.theme: Cloud rug. A flat oval quilted woven mat in powder blue and warm ivory. Three broad softly scalloped white cloud shapes form the woven border pattern; a simple pale-blue sky-colored center. Restrained chunky stitching. Keep the complete outer footprint an ellipse, and keep this visibly flat rather than puffy furniture. No loose pillows.

variants.name: bed-forest-leaf
variants.theme: Forest leaf pet bed. Preserve the reference bed's low round wooden basket, elliptical padded interior and front entrance notch. Change the rim to a honey-brown woven willow basket, add restrained broad green leaf trim to the outside, and use overlapping sage-green leaf-shaped quilted mattress segments.
